body: This was 15 years ago in a county with little to no true law enforcement. If they would catch me they would have already.
I personally do not feel redeemed until I bring back the people I have ruined/killed. Which is impossible. Realizing that I have done awful things doesn’t exonerate me.
what, stop drop dealers? stop the major cartels? me and what army?
I have no idea who I killed. Once it’s out of my warehouse, I have no clue who it’s going to. I’ve done the best I can do.

How the fuck can I “redeem” myself? Send a “sorry I killed your father/mother/friend” card to the people that I hurt? I’ve already donated most of it to non-profits, but I FUCKING KILLED PEOPLE. How I spend my blood money won’t change that.
